title: Tests of star formation metrics in the low-metallicity galaxy NGC 5253 using ALMA observations of H30α line emission
question: What is the SFR of NGC 5253 from H30alpha recombination line emission, and how reliable are SFRs from other commonly used metrics in this low-metallicity dwarf galaxy?

data.bands: Band 6 (231.6 GHz continuum, H30alpha at 231.90 GHz rest)
data.arrays: 12 m main array and Morita (7 m) Array
data.angular_resolution: H30alpha cube beam 0.21x0.19 arcsec; continuum beam 0.28x0.25 arcsec

evidence.quote: we used the globally-integrated flux densities measured from *Herschel* data by (cite: remyruyer13)

what.value: Halpha, Paalpha, Pabeta fluxes and extinction corrections for clusters 5 and 11

evidence.quote: (cite: calzetti15) published H$\alpha$, Pa$\alpha$, and Pa$\beta$ fluxes that have been corrected for foreground dust extinction

what.value: Globally integrated 1.4 GHz flux density 84.7±3.4 mJy

evidence.quote: the globally-integrated measurement of $84.7 \pm 3.4$ mJy from the 1.4 GHz NRAO VLA Sky Survey (cite: condon98)

what.value: Electron temperature 11500 K from [OIII] and density 600 cm^-3 from [OII]/[SII]

evidence.quote: we use 11500 K for the electron temperature, which is based on \[OIII\] measurements

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image H30alpha cube and continuum
recipe.method: CASA calibration per execution block, uv continuum subtraction, clean with Briggs robust 0.5, primary beam correction; natural-weighted continuum image
Curve-of-growth aperture photometry; line flux within 0.3 arcsec radius; continuum within 8.5 arcsec radius; Gaussian fit to image

recipe.goal: Convert H30alpha flux to Q and SFR
recipe.method: Scoville & Murchikova equation with alpha_B and emissivity interpolated from Storey & Hummer; then Starburst99-based Q-to-SFR conversion for Z=0.0056 with/without rotation
assumptions: Nuclear starburst contains most photoionizing stars; Kroupa IMF; continuous star formation >10 Myr; log Q scales linearly with Z; Z≅0.0056

recipe.goal: Compute SFRs from infrared data and total infrared flux
recipe.method: WISE 12/22 micron aperture photometry; Herschel fluxes colour-corrected; TIR from log-log interpolation integrated 12-500 micron, Monte Carlo uncertainties; conversions of Rieke09, Calzetti10, Kennicutt&Evans12 scaled by 0.90/0.72
key_parameters: 150 arcsec source radius, background annulus 450-500 arcsec
assumptions: WISE 22 micron conversion same as Spitzer 24 micron

recipe.goal: Compute SFRs from Halpha with extinction corrections and compare
recipe.method: Halpha fluxes of clusters 5 and 11 from Calzetti15, corrected via Pa lines, 22 micron or TIR; converted with Murphy11 factor 6.43e8; compare all SFRs to H30alpha
